name: Ygril
description: A bold boggart who leads the raid on Boeb's lair, grows into a giant with a potion and is nearly boiled in milk.

description_citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
description_citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Ygril's group finds the pass to Bre's lair has gone into Shadowmoor and decides instead to raid Boeb's lair.
timeline.quote: the lair belonged to Boeb of Clan Boldwyr.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Ygril persuades the others by promising fame greater than Horp's, and sends Lugg and Flib to scout.
timeline.quote: We'll be the first boggarts to successfully rob Boeb.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The boggarts approach Boeb's territory on Marrja and discover seven dead boggarts hanging from a tree.
timeline.quote: just up ahead were seven dead boggarts hanging from the low branch of a tree.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Ygril hears Boeb snoring and explains giants' name sleep, so the boggarts enter the lair.
timeline.quote: a giant's slumber was something called name sleep, triggered only by a sudden change such as trauma or abundance.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The boggarts find the sleeping Boeb looks genial rather than terrible.
timeline.quote: Boeb the Terrible did not look quite so terrible.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The boggarts loot the lair, ferrying treasures away on Marrja, while Ygril secretly stuffs her pouch with potions.
timeline.quote: The friends had agreed to evenly share the loot, but Ygril wanted the choicest potions for herself.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Flib climbs onto Boeb's chest with an eternalisk scale and begins hacking at its string with his axe.
timeline.quote: Flib, as if reading her mind, produced his axe and began to hack at the rope.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Boeb wakes and crushes Flib, and Ygril falls into a copper bucket of old milk and is trapped.
timeline.quote: He twitched, slapped his chest, and crushed poor Flib.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Boeb threatens to dismember and hang the hidden Ygril, but she stays quiet in the bucket.
timeline.quote: Then Boeb will pluck your arms from their joints and suck the marrow from them.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Boeb milks the cloudgoat into the bucket, nearly drowning Ygril, and then puts the bucket over the fire to boil.
timeline.quote: There came the unmistakable crackle of flames as Boeb settled the bucket over the furnace.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Scalded, Ygril drinks a green potion and grows into a giant, wrecking the cave.
timeline.quote: Ygril realized then that she was a giant.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Boeb and giant Ygril brawl; he hurls standing stones and begins choking her as the potion wears off.
timeline.quote: Worse, the potion was spent, and she was starting to shrink to her normal size.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Lugg and Naance return on Marrja, who rakes Boeb's face and tears out his eyes while Ygril pins him.
timeline.quote: to sink her talons into his eyes and tear them out.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The boggarts escape with their loot and celebrate Flib back in their burrow.
timeline.quote: They celebrated Flib—who died foolishly, yes, but in service of something greater.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.

relations.quote: Flib guiding their mount Marrja—a large and ferocious eagle—by her harness.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Much Ado About Thieving" by Tobi Ogundiran. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2026.
